title: If I Had to Make $1000/Day With TikTok Shop Affiliate, I'd Do This
summary: A brand owner recruiting creators says TikTok Shop affiliates can reach $1,000 a day by copying winning formats, batching videos, and stacking retainers and paid-ad payouts.

assertions.quote: I'd be fine. Because I've watched enough people do it to know it isn't complicated.
study what is actually selling products and then steal from those videos

verdicts.note: Imitating proven formats raises hit rates somewhat, but saturation and duplicate-content penalties limit the gain.

assertions.quote: The top creators are making 90 to 180 videos a month, and I promise you they're spending less time than you on each new video.
a video earning $500 in organic commission can generate $5,000 or more in Tribe payouts once a brand puts real ad money behind it

verdicts.note: Payout figures come from a brand owner recruiting creators; there is no independent data on typical earnings.

assertions.quote: it's $1,500 a month for 30 videos of one product
you want to have an account that basically only posts videos in one product category
